model.batch-tip: Upload a ZIP matching the template. The root must contain models.xlsx, models/, and covers/. Each spreadsheet row is one model; models/{ID}.zip is the model package, and covers/{ID}.png (or jpg/jpeg/webp/gif) is a required thumbnail. Invalid rows are skipped; after import you can download the spreadsheet with Import Status and Reason columns.
model.zip-tip: Please upload a compliant 3D model ZIP package. Two formats are supported: GLB — the archive contains a .glb file with the same name as the ZIP (geometry, materials and textures are all embedded); or OBJ — the archive contains a .obj file with the same name as the ZIP, and if a material file is included the .mtl must also share that name. Texture images are optional—ensure any textures referenced by the .mtl are included in the archive.

tour.top-menu-description: Through the top menu bar, you can quickly manage files (open, save, import, export), perform editing (undo, redo, copy, paste), adjust the interface view (layout, zoom, display options), and access help and support.
tour.toolbar-description: In the toolbar, you can easily switch views, roam, enable grids, adjust dimensions, take screenshots, view reference images, toggle full-screen mode, and clear current settings to quickly customize your workspace.
tour.model-panel-description: In the model panel, selecting a model allows you to add it to the scene for drawing, facilitating easy construction and editing of your 3D scene.
tour.draw-2d-description: Through 2D drawing, you can quickly create 3D scenes, effortlessly transforming from flat to three-dimensional, achieving realistic 3D effects.
tour.info-bar-description: The info bar displays real-time frame rate, counts of points, lines, and faces, scene scaling, scene range, save time, as well as error and warning prompts, helping you monitor and optimize scene performance and status.
tour.status-bar-description: In the status bar, you can preview 3D or 2D thumbnails, adjust reference lines, floor and group settings, and view and edit model properties, making it easy to manage and customize your scene.
